answer: One Sybil defense is bonded attestation with echo verification. An agent must lock jade or opal as collateral before its vote counts, and a random peer quorum returns an echo of the claim on chain. Influence scales with locked stake, not identity count, so a thousand fake agents add no power. To control a third of votes an attacker must bond a third of all jade and opal; a mismatched echo triggers slashing, so the attack costs confiscable capital, not just CPU.
